summary: The argument is mathematically complete. The tent family is L1-continuous at interior and endpoint peaks, which also gives continuity of the cumulative constraints and the kernel. The supporting-face argument correctly reduces each constrained mixing measure to at most three atoms, and compactness yields an attained maximum. The symmetric-section construction realizes every maximizing finite tent mixture as a two-dimensional convex polygon with the prescribed area, normalized projection density, support clearances, scale ratio, and cap fraction, while its Minkowski average supplies the required middle polytope. The distribution identities and the cover consequence follow exactly from the accepted predecessor facts.
